- A way to locate your account (your reminder/profile ID or the email/username tied to your reminders)
- Your local “today” window (your time zone or at least your city/UTC offset)

- Hit someone else’s reminders (no account filter)
- Use the wrong day window if your time zone isn’t known

- Share your profile ID or the email/username you use for reminders

- Your account (profile) ID: This is your Apple ID email.
  - Open Settings > [your name] at the top. The email under your name is your Apple ID.
  - Optional: Ensure Reminders syncs with iCloud: Settings > [your name] > iCloud > Show All > make sure Reminders is on.
- Your time zone:
  - Settings > General > Date & Time > Time Zone. If “Set Automatically” is on, note the city/time zone shown.

- Your account (profile) ID: This is your Google Account email.

- Your time zone:
  - Settings > System > Date & time > Time zone. If “Set time zone automatically” is on, you can still see the zone name. Alternatively, in Google Calendar: Menu > Settings > General > Use device time zone (shows the zone).

If you use Samsung Reminders (on Samsung phones)
- Your account (profile) ID: This is your Samsung account email.
  - Settings > Tap your name/Samsung account at the top to see the email.
- Your time zone:
  - Settings > General management > Date and time > Time zone.

- Which reminders platform (iOS Reminders, Google/Tasks, or Samsung Reminders)
